proposal.name: Poll only issues with work to do

plan.name: Poll only issues with work to do
plan.summary: Make factory polls remember successfully observed issue updates and skip unchanged idle issues, so their request cost is independent of the number of idle issues apart from list pagination, while changed comments, bodies and labels are handled on the next poll. Keep unfinished commands, ratified builds and issue plans, watched pull requests and CI, failed reads or effects, and running or queued steps eligible without duplicate execution or losing changes observed during a step; new watchers rediscover work and existing lease, closure, recovery and heartbeat behavior remains intact. Replace the five active-label queries with one paginated ClosedIssues(ctx, since) query, filtering active labels locally, scanning existing closed work on startup and then using an overlapping successful-poll watermark while retaining unfinished cleanup and independently discovering merges. Revalidate repeated GitHub REST GETs, including list pages, issues, comments, events, pull requests and check runs, with their ETags and reuse the matching body on 304, with concurrency-safe bounded caching isolated by request and authentication, fresh pagination, and errors or mutations never mistaken for unchanged success. Update SPEC.md and docs/factory.md to describe this tested polling and conditional-read behavior with the existing decision foundations D-0069, D-0105, D-0113, D-0122, D-0237, D-0294 and D-0299; the merger must record the new polling decision because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestPoll514IdleRequestCost
tests.says: After discovery, unchanged idle issues cost only shared list calls regardless of their count; a new watcher still discovers them and every poll emits its heartbeat.

tests.name: TestPoll514ChangesAndReadRetries
tests.says: Comments, body edits and trigger labels wake only the changed issues on the next poll, and a failed read is retried without another update.

tests.name: TestPoll514CIAndPullRequestChanges
tests.says: An unchanged issue waiting on a pull request observes CI and a person's closure on the next poll while unrelated idle issues are skipped.

tests.name: TestPoll514ClosedScanAndCleanupRetry
tests.says: One incremental closed-issue query replaces label scans, includes old active work on startup, filters unrelated history and retains interrupted cleanup across watermark advances and failed polls.

tests.name: TestPoll514MergeAfterClosure
tests.says: A merge wakes its already-closed issue even without a new issue timestamp, is recorded once, and does not wake unrelated idle issues.

tests.name: TestPoll514RunningAndQueuedWork
tests.says: Running and queued builds survive repeated polls without duplicate runs; after they finish, CI is observed despite unchanged issue timestamps, while idle work is skipped.

tests.name: TestPoll514ChangeDuringStep
tests.says: A poll that sees an update while the issue's previous step is still reading does not consume that update; the next poll after the step ends handles it exactly once.

tests.name: TestPoll514RatifiedIssuePlanContinues
tests.says: A ratified issue plan continues to open its next issue after a child's merge without its own timestamp moving, while an unrelated idle issue is skipped.

tests.name: TestGitHub514ConditionalReads
tests.says: Repeated REST reads send the saved ETag, decode the matching cached body on 304 without aliasing returned objects, and replace it when GitHub returns a changed representation.

tests.name: TestGitHub514ConditionalPages
tests.says: Paginated reads revalidate each page with its own ETag, retain unchanged pages, and follow changed pagination when pages grow or disappear.

tests.name: TestGitHub514CacheIsolationAndErrors
tests.says: Conditional reads isolate repositories and credentials, surface transient and permission errors, never cache errors as success, and observe mutations on the following read.

tests.name: TestGitHub514ClosedIssuesSince
tests.says: ClosedIssues uses a paginated closed-state query with an optional encoded since timestamp, returns all labels for local filtering, and excludes pull requests.

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` and 12 acceptance tests covering selective polling, incremental closed-issue discovery, ETag revalidation, and continued processing of pending work. The check passed: all tests fail on the base code as required, and `repo/` is unchanged.
